full_en: Profusa is a digital health technology company based in Berkeley, California, that has invested over the last twelve years more than $100 million from sophisticated venture investors as well as the most sophisticated research institutions in the U.S. (including approximately $30 million from Defense Advance Research Projects Agency, or DARPA, and the National Institutes of Health, or NIH) to develop a unique biosensor platform that is easily injected subcutaneously to provide, for the first time, real-time, individual biochemistry, that is cost effective while functioning for more than six times longer than known best-in-class solutions on the market today.
